summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi GLXY 2x Daily ETF (GLX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Galaxy Digital Holdings Ltd. (GLXY) which operates as a diversified financial services and infrastructure firm focused on digital assets, cryptocurrency, and AI data centers. GLX was launched on Jun 30, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
